MidiKeyInput(MidiState, MidiState)

Creates a osu.Framework.Input.StateChanges.MidiKeyInput from the difference of two osu.Framework.Input.States.MidiStates.

public MidiKeyInput(MidiState currentState, MidiState previousState)

Parameters

currentState MidiState

The newer osu.Framework.Input.States.MidiState.

previousState MidiState

The older osu.Framework.Input.States.MidiState.

Remarks

Buttons that are pressed in previousState and not pressed in currentState will be listed as osu.Framework.Input.StateChanges.ButtonStateChangeKind.Released. Buttons that are not pressed in previousState and pressed in currentState will be listed as osu.Framework.Input.StateChanges.ButtonStateChangeKind.Pressed. Key velocities from currentState always take precedence over velocities from previousState.
